paragraphs: Every hot lead across your organization — people who replied to your outreach with real interest — newest first, as enriched contacts ready to map into CRM fields. Polling: pass since (ISO 8601) with your last poll time to get only leads that went hot after it — the Zapier/Make pattern. became_hot_at of the newest item is your next cursor. A lead leaves the feed when you dismiss it in the inbox («Not a hot lead») or when it later unsubscribes. To read the full conversation or answer: GET /autogtm/campaigns/{campaign_id}/inbox/{person_id} and …/reply.
